verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data, including a Create-Dashboard tool that builds a dashboard with text cards and reports. An agent can also query events, funnels and retention in natural language, so it can identify key metrics and assemble a dashboard without the UI. missing for 10: detailed docs on how the agent defines or configures the individual report cards (metrics, filters, layout), a REST API path for dashboard creation (the Query API only reads results), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent-built dashboard.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
